Ingredients for bread roll, (Here we prepared 9 bread rolls, adjust as per your requirements) Note: Here we have used mainly potato as a filling you can replace it with mashed chicken, panner or any other stuff to make other variants like chicken bread roll or cheese bread roll.

  • 3-4 boiled potato
  • 1/2 to 1 tbsp red chilli powder
  • Salt as par your taste
  • 3-4 chopped small green chilli
  • some chopped fresh coriander
  • 1 small bowl milk
  • 1/2 to 1 tbsp coriander powder
  • 1/2 to 1 tbsp chaat masala
  • 8-9 breads
  • Edible oil for frying - 8-10 tbsp or as per your requirement.

Steps,

First mash potato for filling with the help of hands as shown in the video. Add red chilli powder, salt, coriander, coriander powder and chat masala powder Mix and mash well to prepare filling

In a plate pour some milk and put bread in milk plate as shown in the video Now put the filling in the bread and give the bread a rounded shape as shown. Prepare the rounded balls for remaining bread as shown in the video.

Now take one wok or pan.Pour oil. Once oil is heated add the rounded rolls slowly in the oil. Fry the rolls till they are brown in color. Keep moving slowly to make sure that every part is cooked.

Take out it in serving plate. If required take the extra oil from rolls with the help of paper towel. You can enjoy bread rolls with tomato, chilli sauce or homemade chutney.
